title: selected.json — reaction-scoped fix selection
description: The reaction-scoped fix selection: the finding sigs whose posted root review comment carries at least one human 👍, written by a GitHub fetch (the only host whose reactions verdict reads) and read by fix --selected. No reaction leaves no file at all, because an empty selection would claim a scope nobody asked for.

repo.description: Repository whose review comments were read, owner/name.

pr.description: Pull-request number the selected comments belong to.

head_sha.description: The bundle head the selection was read at (the fetched head, not the live one).

selected_at.description: UTC timestamp of the read, RFC 3339.

sigs.description: Finding sigs (40-hex) whose root review comment carries at least one human 👍, sorted and deduplicated. Bots and a comment's own poster never count, and a reply is never the root, so only verdict's own posted finding comment can select a sig. fix --selected addresses exactly these sigs.
